name: Advasa Holdings Inc.
summary: Advasa Holdings, Inc. is a financial technology and services company focused on earned wage access and employee financial benefits. Through its Japanese subsidiary, Advasa Co., Ltd., the company operates FUKUPE, a proprietary platform that enables employees to access wages they have already earned before their regular payday through cashless payment and settlement systems integrated with wallets, cards, and bank accounts. The company also licenses its earned wage access technology and provides original equipment manufacturer and system maintenance services to businesses.
